sourceRefs.locator: IX.39, opening: Clotild, Basina, the group’s departure from Poitiers and appeal to Gregory in Tours, followed by the bishop’s version of his answer.
Section on the nuns of Poitiers, pp. 136–142; narrative setting of the 589 appeal, inserted letters in IX.39–42 and the episcopal tribunal of 590 in X.16.

labels.de: Die aus Poitiers nach Tours gekommenen Nonnen
labels.en: Nuns who went from Poitiers to Tours

summary.de: Gregor berichtet von einer Gruppe von vierzig oder mehr Nonnen um Chrodechilde und Basina, die das Kloster verließen.
summary.en: Gregory reports that a group of forty or more nuns left the convent with Clotild and Basina.
